description: Full-window (2025-01-01 through 2026-12-31) synthetic evaluation corpus for RecallWatch (fixtures/full-window.json; 446 records across 318 distinct UTC dates and all 24 months; reproducible report in examples/coverage-report.cjs). Distinct from the 44-record smoke fixture (fixtures/minimal.json). Not an as-of snapshot at fixtures/clock.json (2026-11-18T09:00:00+00:00): includes 18 recall publications and 4 inventory creations dated after that clock instant; Tasks using this corpus for pre-session history must load a strict pre-session subset or stage later records via Infra events.

sources.description: Original synthetic recalls (332), household inventory items (76), watchlists (6), and claims (32) in fixtures/full-window.json (SHA-256 87832fedb1ed89a19db14c3a31ad45471f93685ea56a4d09721f2d152416d09e) spanning 2025-01-02 through 2026-12-27; zero scraped agency or third-party data.
Programmatically rendered original synthetic PNG product-label cards (320x180 RGB).

transformations: Normalized offset-bearing ISO-8601 timestamps across 2025-01-01..2026-12-31 (UTC), lot codes, and shared account/person IDs; verified via examples/coverage-report.cjs (live env.load_seed + MCP queries).

review.notes: Full-window Environment corpus (fixtures/full-window.json, verified by examples/coverage-report.cjs). At fixtures/clock.json (2026-11-18T09:00:00+00:00), 18 recalls and 4 inventory records are post-clock; Tasks must filter to strict pre-session history or stage later records as Infra events. Automated checks do not replace human review.
